paras: In furtherance of achieving some measure of justice for victims of Epstein and his acolytes, I ask that any
belonging to Epstein's estate or co-conspirators be seized by federal authorities. We believe that this
was used by Epstein and others to facilitate the commission and prolonged concealment of his trafficking of children, such that seizure may be pursued in conjunction with the pending
prosecution of Epstein's associates and co-conspirators.
